regime_gross_exposure._note: Trend-aware gross-exposure cap. When enabled it overrides max_gross_exposure_pct: bull_pct while the market-trend signal is bullish, bear_pct otherwise, read as of the session before each fill. signal 'breadth' = % of the strategies' universe closing above its own SMA (smoothed, with hysteresis: bullish from bull_on_pct, not bullish below bull_off_pct); 'index' = benchmark weekly close vs weekly SMA (same test as market_regime). Applies at buy time only - never sells to get under a lower cap. Visualize with scripts/trend_signals.py before enabling.
